jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: ・This position will be part of Pfizer ES Global Biopharmaceuticals Group (1) and will be responsible for oversight of CMOs that supply products. ・This position is responsible for managing business relations, operations and performance from a portfolio of Contract Manufacturers Organisations (CMOs) and Partners located in Japan; with accountability and full P&L responsibility for significant external spend. This position works closely with other ES Operations Leaders, Supply Chain Planners, ES Quality, GTE and Customers at Business Units and Markets with global responsibility for quality, supply and cost from an assigned base of Contractors and Partners. The ES Operations Leader develops and manages implementation of the strategy and tactical execution to ensure timely supply of Drug Products and to achieve cost targets as well as all other key metrics for External Supply Emerging Markets & China (ES EMC). He/she also strongly contributes to the development and execution of ES EMC Virtual Site strategies. POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES: -The ES Operations Lead is responsible for the relationship, and for the performance of the CMOs and Partners in his/her area of portfolio which are located primarily within Japan . Short-term tactics as well as long-term strategies must ensure that every CMO contributes to achieving ES EMC Integrated Manufacturing Excellence metrics and strategic objectives. -Lead Virtual Site Operations Teams (VSOTs) and provide matrix leadership to all members of the VSOT including but not limited to ES Quality, PPLs, BSLs, supply chain planners, procurement and GTE project leads. The ES Operations Lead is accountable for the results of the VSOT. The activities and responsibilities of the VSOT include: Manage global stakeholders including but not limited to Product Portfolio Leaders, Brand Supply leaders and Commercial and PGS leadership Have P&L responsibility for a complex selected portfolio including direct accountability for contract negotiations and external relationship management at CEO level with the contractor base Development and execution of manufacturing and supply plans and meet market demand for product and meet or exceed supply performance target; this includes supply of APIs, raw materials and components where appropriate. Development and execution of tactical plans for continuous improvement of CMO shop floor performance in the areas of product quality, EH&S, compliance, customer service and cost. Review of the status of deviations which impact or may affect product supply. The ES Operations Lead is responsible to secure correct and timely closing of relevant deviations, and when necessary, lead closure of investigations that have not been properly addressed by the CMO. - Oversee and secure timely execution of new product introduction, product changes (including changes of materials and API), product enhancement, localization and product transfer programs. Lead implementation teams where required. -Ensure that product supply, quality, compliance and cost issues at CMOs are adequately addressed by making extensive use of Operational Excellence tools and mobilizing the necessary resources for support in all required areas. Lead these cross-functional teams where required. -Collaborate with EH&S to ensure compliance with environmental, health and safety regulations and Pfizer requirements. -Ensure effective communication of key product supply issues to stakeholders, communication with CM Site Leads and Vice Presidents, with PGS PPLs, and with ES Leadership. -Partner with ES Quality to ensure CMOs comply with regulatory requirements, cGMP’s, Pfizer Quality Standards and Standard Operating Procedures. -Manage the cost reduction program: Identify cost reduction opportunities with CMOs Validate the financial impact and secure the opportunities are captured and reported in the Long Range Plan and the Operational Plan Oversee execution and implementation, lead the team for execution as appropriate Meet or exceed annual budget cost reduction target -Maintain awareness of potential new sourcing opportunities and identify strategic sourcing partners for the manufacture/packaging/testing of pharmaceutical products who share common vision/values with PGS. -Ensure compliance with Legal Requirements of the “ My Anti-corruption Policy & Procedures (MAPP)” and related other legislation as directed by the relevant Pfizer Corporate Policies. The ES Operations Lead is accountable for appropriate documentation of compliance with all requirements. -Support and actively participate in ES initiatives to drive the business and to enable delivery of key metrics -Lead assigned project and initiatives for his/her portfolio of contractors including but notlimited to: Serialization Business Continuity Plans Supplier Network Collaboration Environmental Sustainability -20 - 25% travel required (primarily across Japan). KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS: 1.Supply performance: meet the targets set under ES Integrated Manufacturing Excellence balanced scorecard. 2.Product cost reduction. 3.Quality: no rejects or recalls due to contract manufacturer errors. TECHNICAL SKILL REQUIREMENTS: Level of Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree (Science, Engineering, Pharmacy, Economics, Business); MBA preferred. Experience: Minimum 9 years experience (with advanced degree) in Pharmaceutical Operations (especially in API, vaccines, sterile injectables and/or solid-oral dose) Global Technology, Engineering and Launch (GTEL), Supply Chain or Quality Operations. External Supply, Procurement, R&D and or Project Management experience is also highly desirable. Languages: Must be able to communicate in written and spoken Japanese and English Other Specifics & know-how: Excellent verbal and written communication skills including a demonstrated ability to lead and participate in teams at all levels of management required. Well-developed interpersonal skills (leadership, integrity, team orientation, flexibility, creativity; experience in projects that require collaborative approaches; strong analytical skills; ability to understand business issues and processes; knowledge and understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and regulatory requirements. Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) A Master’s degree coupled with significant pharmaceutical experience Familiarity with industry standards for Good Manufacturing Practices in drug product manufacturing operations. Strong understanding of Supply Chain discipline Excellent negotiation skills for managing essential contracts and agreements Ability to influence and drive teams towards achieving division targets High degree of adaptability and problem-solving skills in complex project environments Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. jobs.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on UK public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialised role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organisations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of UK Government and defence organisations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.

Location: UK

Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance preferred; candidates with Active Secret clearance or those who are eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.

What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

- Own end-to-end technical program delivery for UK public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

- Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

- Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

- Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

- Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organisation, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

- Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

- Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

- Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

- Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

- Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

- Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, security authorisations, technical and infrastructure constraints

- Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

- Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

- Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customisation, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

- Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

- Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.

You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

- 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

- Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

- Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

- Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

- Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

- Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

- Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

- Deep understanding of how government organisations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

- Familiarity with UK government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

- Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

- Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

- Eligible to obtain UK government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:

- Active UK government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - preference for active Top Secret clearance

- Background in or strong familiarity with UK defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

- Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

- Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.

Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for UK government security clearance.

Preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active UK government Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:

- Currently hold UK government Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

- Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

- Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.

What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialised role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of the UK’s most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organisations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how the UK leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of. Who We Are… When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next… From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive. Avalanche is a Warner Bros. Games studio located in downtown Salt Lake City nestled against the backdrop of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. We’ve been in the video game business since 1995, creating interactive experiences for fans of the world’s largest franchises. Join the team behind the blockbuster open world, action RPG Hogwarts Legacy as we create what’s next! Avalanche, a division of WB Games Inc., is seeking a Mission Level Designer to join our team of talented industry veterans. In this role, you will guide the creative vision and execution of missions, owning the player experience from concept through final implementation. As both a mission implementer and player-focused storyteller, you will shape gameplay, pacing, and spatial design while collaborating across disciplines to deliver cohesive, immersive experiences. The ideal candidate brings a passion for game design and The Wizarding World. What part will you play? Mission Ownership, Structure & Player Experience: Collaborate on the design and deliver compelling missions from concept through final implementation. Define mission structure, pacing, and gameplay flow across combat, exploration, and narrative beats, ensuring the player experience is intuitive, engaging, and aligned with the game’s creative vision. Communicate objectives and progression through level design, using spatial layout, encounter design, and environmental storytelling rather than relying on explicit instruction. Implementation & Scripting: Implement missions using visual scripting tools, establishing core logic, progression, triggers, and integration with game systems. Deliver functional, stable content that is consistently ready for QA, internal reviews, and playtests. Iteration, Feedback & Quality Refinement: Champion an iterative development process by proactively gathering feedback through reviews, cross-disciplinary input, and playtesting. Translate feedback and insights into actionable improvements, continuously refining mission flow, difficulty, readability, and emotional impact. Creative Input: Serve as a key creative contributor in defining each mission’s purpose, tone, emotional arc, and learning opportunities. Ensure missions not only succeed on their own terms, but also support progression goals, reinforce the broader player journey, and contribute meaningfully to the overall game experience. Cross-Disciplinary Leadership & Communication: Act as the mission’s point of ownership and alignment across disciplines, driving communication with design, art, audio, narrative, engineering, and other partners as needed. Anticipate dependencies, surface risks early, and maintain momentum by identifying opportunities, proposing solutions, and guiding the mission forward through initiative and ownership. Mentorship & Design Stewardship: Uphold design standards, share best practices and support the growth of other designers through feedback, collaboration and by example. Help elevate the craft of mission design across the project through thoughtful critique and a strong understanding of the player experience. What do we need from you? Industry experience as a Level Designer, with a track record of owning missions from concept to final implementation. Solid experience in Unreal Engine 5, including level creation workflows, tools, and best practices in a production environment. Proficient in Blueprints (UE5), including the ability to implement and troubleshoot gameplay logic, mission flow, and scripted events with a high degree of autonomy. Strong understanding of mission flow, spatial composition, gameplay pacing, and player guidance across combat, exploration, and narrative-driven moments. Proven cross-disciplinary leadership, with experience collaborating closely with art, narrative, engineering, and design to align contributors around a shared creative vision. Excellent communication and feedback skills, with the ability to both receive direction thoughtfully and provide clear, constructive feedback to others. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership, anticipate development needs, and continuously drive work forward. Solid creative judgment and design sensibility, with the ability to contribute original ideas while balancing player experience, production constraints, and overall game goals. A passion for games, level design, and crafting exceptional player experiences. How We Get Things Done… This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview. Championing Inclusion at WBD Warner Bros. ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the full commercial relationship and customer’s success across a book of 100 to 200 corporate accounts - the builders, founders, and product teams at companies up to 250 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction.

This is a high-volume, high-impact role. You won't succeed by managing accounts one at a time - you'll build the systems, playbooks, and scaled motions that let you drive meaningful outcomes across a diverse book. If you love the challenge of figuring out how to operate at scale without losing the quality of the customer relationship, this role was built for you.

On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value.

Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs’ expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don’t just retain customers, they grow with them.

COMPENSATION

This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 100% net revenue retention (NRR) with an emphasis on product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis.

REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 2 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you know what good looks like in a technical, fast-moving customer environment

- A track record of owning commercial outcomes: quota, renewals, cross-sell, and the full expansion motion from identifying the opportunity to closing it

- Comfortable managing a high-volume book of business with a systems mindset - you build playbooks and repeatable motions, not just individual relationships

- Hands-on familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs; you can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust

- Experience using product usage data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn

- Strong communicator who can move fluidly between a founder, a technical lead, and a procurement team in the same week

Preferred

- Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space

- Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform

LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities.

jobs.description:
Come shape the future with us! As a major cloud provider, our technology powers many of the world's largest organizations. We are now building QuickSuite - a new and exciting Generative AI application that will transform how enterprises operate.

Quick Spaces is where teams in Amazon Quick bring their knowledge together: the files, documents, dashboards and data they rely on every day. Spaces makes that knowledge easy to organize, share and search, and it grounds Amazon Quick's AI chat and agents in each customer's own content.

You will have the exciting opportunity to be on the ground floor of developing this product. We are seeking creative problem-solvers who are energized by tackling complex technical challenges to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. Our team collaborates closely across roles to rapidly build, test and iterate as we create an AI solution that delivers real business value. Join our innovative team to leave your mark on the next generation of AI. This is an exciting role, with high visibility and high impact, leading several customer facing initiatives for Quick Spaces under the Amazon Quick organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in front-end development, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality user experiences.

Key job responsibilities
As a lead software development engineer on the Quick team, you will design and develop features for Quick Spaces in the Amazon Quick product. You will work with scientists and engineers within Amazon AI and develop high quality software that is robust and reliable.

You will be responsible for:

- Building the experiences customers use to create, organize, share and search their Spaces across web and desktop

- Providing technical leadership and contribute to the definition, development, integration, test, documentation, and support of new AI Services

- Driving software engineering best practices

- Instill best practices for software development and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules

About the team
**Diverse Experiences**
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

**Why AWS?**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

**Inclusive Team Culture**
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

**Mentorship & Career Growth**
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**Work/Life Balance**
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
